data.name: Akshikaa
data.gender_notes: Akshikaa is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Akshikaa is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'akshara', which means 'letter' or 'symbol'. The name signifies one who embodies knowledge and wisdom. In Hindu mythology, Akshikaa is believed to be an incarnation of the goddess Saraswati, the deity of learning and wisdom. The name Akshikaa carries the meaning “Wisdom, Knowledge” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Akshikaa usually hope their child will grow to embody wisdom, knowledge and live with faith, good character and purpose.
